one_line: British East India Company commander leading a hard-fought assault at the Battle of Assaye, 1803.

appearance.age_look: Early 30s, tall and lean, athletic military build.
appearance.face: Long oval face with a straight aquiline nose, fair-to-rosy complexion weathered by the Indian sun, sharp dark eyes with pronounced brows, clean-shaven with a firm jawline; default expression calm, focused and slightly stern, as if constantly assessing a battlefield.
appearance.hair: Short, wavy dark brown hair brushed back from the forehead, neatly trimmed over the ears and nape; no facial hair; wears a dark blue bicorne hat with gold edging and a black cockade on the left side.
appearance.costume: Early 19th-century British army general’s dress adapted for field use: a dark navy-blue tailcoat with high standing collar and bright red facings, the collar and cuffs trimmed with narrow gold braid; the coat is double-breasted with two rows of plain brass buttons, worn closed high on the chest; beneath it a white linen shirt with a simple folded collar and a black stock (neckcloth) tied snugly; buff-coloured waistcoat just visible at the front; white crossbelt of leather worn over the right shoulder holding a small black leather cartridge pouch at the left hip; wide buff leather waist belt with a plain brass buckle; buff-coloured riding breeches tucked into knee-high black leather riding boots with slight square toes and low heels; minimal jewellery, just a simple signet ring on one hand; overall fabric looks slightly dusty and sweat-darkened from campaign conditions, but always orderly and buttoned.
appearance.signature: A single straight-bladed British infantry officer’s sword with a slightly curved brass stirrup hilt and simple knuckle bow, carried in a plain steel scabbard on his left hip; he holds it with steady, disciplined posture, blade clean and practical rather than ornamental.

ref_desc: Tall, lean Arthur Wellesley with fair weathered face, short wavy dark brown hair and a navy bicorne, wearing a navy tailcoat with red facings, buff breeches, black riding boots, white crossbelt and buff waist belt, carrying a plain brass-hilted officer’s sword.
sheet_prompt: Draw a full-body anime-style character model sheet of Arthur Wellesley at the 1803 Battle of Assaye: a tall, lean British commander in his early 30s with a long oval fair face, sharp dark eyes, short wavy dark brown hair brushed back, and a dark navy bicorne hat edged in gold with a black cockade on the left. Show his calm, focused, slightly stern expression. He wears an early 19th-century British general’s dark navy tailcoat with a high standing collar and bright red facings, the collar and cuffs trimmed in narrow gold braid, double-breasted with two rows of brass buttons, worn closed high on the chest over a white linen shirt, black neck stock, and a buff waistcoat just peeking through. Give him a white leather crossbelt over his right shoulder to a small black cartridge pouch at his left hip, and a wide buff leather waist belt with a plain brass buckle. His buff riding breeches tuck into knee-high black leather riding boots with low heels. The coat and belts should look slightly dusty and sweat-marked from campaign use but tidy and disciplined. At his left hip hangs a steel-scabbarded straight infantry officer’s sword with a slightly curved brass stirrup hilt and knuckle bow, which he holds or rests a hand upon as his clear signature weapon. Use a palette dominated by navy blue, bright red, buff tan, white, and black, and present him front, side, and back so the face, hair, costume details, and sword can be consistently redrawn.
